test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He and his friends / does not / want to / attend the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "does not" used with the subject "He and his friends".
 
• For plural subjects, "do not" should be used instead of "does not".
 
• The correct phrase should be "He and his friends do not want to attend the meeting," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He and his friends do not want to attend the meeting."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"He and his friends"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"want to"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"attend the meeting"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
